prompts.prompt: Create ONE continuous opaque landscape stage BACKGROUND image, native 16:9 1672x941, for a side-view 2.5D fighting game. This is a source-driven adaptation of the exact existing game location shown in the reference frames, not a new environment. Treat the reference frames as visual ground truth; match their architectural motifs, materials and restrained palette. The reference people, monsters, subtitles, score, HUD, crosshairs and logos are reference contaminants and must all be absent. Camera is a horizontal lateral elevation with only shallow depth, eye level approximately 1.5 metres, no fisheye, no dramatic vanishing-point corridor. Lower 30 percent is a broad physically continuous clear floor, a horizontal combat footing at y=0.87, traversable across the central 86 percent. Keep the full fighter-height silhouette area readable. Empty environmental plate, no characters or character silhouettes, no weapons carried by actors, no text, no panels, no border, no watermark. Preserve the measured game-scene character rather than adding cinematic decorations. Natural detailed textures and subtle grounded light; do not invent machinery or dramatic debris. EXACT SCENE: Silent Hill 4: The Room, final sacrament chamber beneath Room 302, static empty environment. Read the first reference for the cracked gray stone annular walkway, simple gray vertical masonry posts and horizontal top beam, deep burgundy-red wall fields, rounded-top gray standing stelae on small stepped stone bases, and the static faded red human motifs painted flat on those stelae. Those motifs are in-world painted images, not living people. Read the second frame for the circular chamber arrangement and dark crimson central basin. Read the third solely for the shallow ribbed gray dome with a small bright white circular oculus; remove Henry and Walter entirely. Compose a tangent side view from the near stone perimeter: an unbroken cracked gray stone walkway occupies the whole bottom 30 percent. The dark red central basin starts BEHIND that clear walking plane at roughly y=0.65 and remains safely in the middle distance; no foreground hole or drop. Far wall shows three visible rounded-top stelae spaced between simple masonry posts, their faint red painted human motifs small and weathered, with only the reference spear-like ritual pieces held against those rear monuments. A modest, partially cropped interlocking dark iron ring mechanism sits far back toward the right behind the combat plane, matching the low heavy spiked rings in reference 1; keep it visibly mechanical and not enormous. The top quarter shows the shallow radially ribbed dome and pale oculus, restrained gray light falling across the stone. Deep gray and burgundy palette, muted rather than neon. No Walter, Henry, Eileen, Conjurer, corpses, bodies, supernatural energy, moving ritual, blood splashes, extra creature sculpture, altar, Gothic arch, fire, candles, chains, flowing curtains or fleshy invented wall. Maintain a modest enclosed circular room, not a gigantic cathedral.
